title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache and parallelism
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflows made it hard to iterate on lint/test/release automation, resulted in long runtimes and cache contention. This PR splits the combined workflow into dedicated lint, test, and release flows, standardizes cache keys, enables parallel matrix runs where safe, and consolidates reusable workflow templates to improve maintainability and cache hit rates. Work completed: - split workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml (moved shared steps into .github/workflows/templates/) - introduced deterministic cache keys per-language and per-lockfile to reduce cache churn (hashFiles on package-lock.json / poetry.lock / go.sum) - parallelized lint jobs: separate JS/TS and Python linters to avoid cross-language noise; enabled concurrency: matrix: node-version / python-version where applicable - improved build matrix caching: moved common setup to reusable job and used actions/cache v4 with primary+restore keys - updated release automation to decouple publishing from nightly checks and to add a final gating job that verifies artifacts exist - hygiene: bumped GH Actions versions (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4), removed deprecated workflow syntax, added comments and short migration guide in CONTRIBUTING.md Checkout/checklist: - [x] Split workflows and created templates - [x] Verified local dry-run with act (where possible) - [x] CI green on fork and main branch - [x] Reviewed and addressed feedback from reviewers Migration notes: existing self-hosted runners may need to update container images for new actions; ops will be notified. Impact/risk: low — no behavior changes to production code, CI-only. Rollout: merged to main with squash; monitor CI run times and cache hit rates over the next 2 weeks.

files_changed: .github/workflows/lint.yml — split from monolith; jobs: lint-js, lint-python; added concurrency and self-hosted runner hints
.github/workflows/test.yml — Node/Python unit + integration split; uses workflow_call templates for setup
.github/workflows/release.yml — decoupled publish step; added gating job to validate artifacts before publish
.github/workflows/templates/setup-node.yml — reusable job for node setup and cache restore (key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }})
.github/workflows/templates/setup-python.yml — reusable python setup with poetry cache key on poetry.lock
actions/versions.txt — bumped recommended actions versions and recorded changelog links
CONTRIBUTING.md — CI section updated with migration instructions and troubleshooting tips
.github/ci-scripts/ci_cache_hints.sh — helper to compute cache keys for composite actions
docs/ci/README.md — added notes on workflow split, expected runner labels and how to opt into parallelism

Morgan Lee (reviewer): Release job looks good but we should gate publish by artifact existence; also add a safety timeout on retries for flaky network calls.
Author (Priya Patel): Added gating job 'verify-artifacts' and a 30s retry backoff for the publish action. Tests in a staging run passed.
Diego Ramirez (reviewer): A few linter warnings surfaced for repo root scripts after upgrading setup-node — I recommend adding node-version matrix conservative range to avoid flakes.
Author (Priya Patel): Reduced node-version matrix to [18,20] and pinned setup-node@v4 to avoid auto-major behavior.
